    S = 256
    W = world_size
    
    # Preserve input dtype
    dtype = x.dtype
    
    # Define per-shard scale factors
    a = [1.0 + 0.5 * (r % 3) for r in range(W)]
    
    # Stage 1: All-reduce, scale, all-reduce, unscale
    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, x)
    
    buf = s.clone()
    for r in range(W):
        buf[r*S:(r+1)*S] = a[r] * s[r*S:(r+1)*S] / W
    
    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, buf)
    
    for r in range(W):
        s[r*S:(r+1)*S] = s[r*S:(r+1)*S] / max(a[r], 1e-9)
    
    # Stage 2: Scale, all-reduce, unscale
    buf = s.clone()
    for r in range(W):
        buf[r*S:(r+1)*S] = a[r] * s[r*S:(r+1)*S] / W
    
    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, buf)
    
    for r in range(W):
        s[r*S:(r+1)*S] = s[r*S:(r+1)*S] / max(a[r], 1e-9)
    
    # Stage 3: Scale, all-reduce
    buf = s.clone()
    for r in range(W):
        buf[r*S:(r+1)*S] = a[r] * s[r*S:(r+1)*S] / W
    
    s = xm.all_reduce(xm.REDUCE_SUM, buf)
